enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Insightful Intelligence +6: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Insightful Wisdom +6: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Wisdom.
Insightful Charisma +6: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Charisma.

enchantments.tooltip: Profane Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Profane bonus to the DC of all spells.
Insightful Resistance +4: Passive: +4 Insight bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Insightful Dodge +6%: +6% Insightful bonus to Dodge.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
